collection.title: BMW 5 Series Saloon 2010 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 5 Series Saloon 2010 to 2016 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
